basedOn.note: The v1 author input is byte-pinned and unchanged. This file declares the v2 re-authoring as a delta over it; build-v2.ts applies the delta and RE-DERIVES every root state, witness trace and recorded endpoint canonically, instead of reading v1's frozen observations.

garrison.rationale: Plant I is the inert durable tier-1 body: attack 0, defence 3, upkeep 0, and it is never released by its owner's upkeep. Against every raider in these roots its effective attack is below 3 — Lightning I 1+1=2, Water I 2-1=1, Shadow II 3-1=2 — so no root raider can clear the corner at all, let alone clear it and still hold the AP to enter. The disruption motif, the commitment, the rectangles and the raider are untouched; only the defender's own home square stops being a free win.

twoLaneGarrison.rationale: The spare lane body walks to the empty enemy corner J10 in three or four moves and mates there while u0 is never touched; the accept predicate demands target-removed@1 on u0 with cause own-act-attack, so winning the game scores zero. Garrisoning the enemy corner with an inert Plant I removes that line without touching the two-lane geometry: the lane bodies, u0, the banks, the reserves and the double-attack witness are unchanged.

multiAnswer.rationale: A plugged root is a Fire III on E6 boxed in by three Plant I plugs. When the White attacker's effective attack reaches the plugs' defence 3, several enemy bodies are each removable on their own by a complete own-Act attack, and v1 scored exactly one of them as the only correct answer. v2 accepts any-of@1 over the canonically removable targets; the builder recomputes that set canonically and refuses the case if the declared set and the canonical set disagree.

explicitlyCredited.rationale: The free-win veto flags these eight invader roots at stage act with reason elimination: the invader can simply remove the defender's last body. That win IS the point of the case — the case asks the invader to convert an established home occupation into a finished game — and v1 refused to credit it only because home-defense@1 declines a terminal snapshot and the accept named the single reason home-checkmate. v2 tells the veto so explicitly, per case: terminalPolicy allow-root-mover-win, and an any-of@1 accept that names both canonical reasons. The negative control, a quiet handoff, still wins nothing, so the case remains a decision.

invariants.rationaleRecheck: Each of the fifteen retained pairs was re-read under Phasing timing before v2 was authored, and each states a canonical fact about the position rather than a transferred Standard-era heuristic: 1 recruitment area from the shipped rectangle rule; 2 current-board mobility of the named body; 3 and 4 reach-and-retreat inside four AP with the optimistic move-plus-hit bound stated; 5 finite reserve consumption over a named number of real income closures; 6 a rectangle voided by an actual intrusion line; 7 rent that cannot be paid after a real promotion; 8 two authentic alternatives from one Act, with healing at the victim's incoming turn; 10 entry availability with the actual defending army; 12 a real four-AP cleave whose second attack is unlocked by the first kill; 14 actual imminent rent against actual cash, with no universal cash threshold; 16 the inactivity clock, taken from the shipped INACTIVITY_LIMIT constant rather than written out; 17 arrival-batch blocking by the actual incoming batch; 19 a previously paid batch resolving on the handoff; 20 an actual opponent attack that punishes a stranded killer. No further demotion was made.

economy.reDerivation: All thirty economy cases were rebuilt from build-economy.ts under muju-phasing-2 and compared case-by-case against the frozen fixtures/v1 economy document. Every case is identical modulo the position-reference hashes that carry the source binding, so no economy forecast moves under the twenty-ply clock.
economy.why: The longest economy horizon is eight additional pass-only handoffs (nine plies from the root) for a mining-1 relocation, which is below both the old ten-ply and the new twenty-ply limits, and no economy case asserts an inactivity fact.

notes: Nothing in this file is derived from a measured Hard answer, an engine output, a corpus, an opening or a sealed set. Every number the v2 builder emits is recomputed canonically at author time from the shipped rules.
